id: title:jakesciotto:keep marketo export stream open to eof

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the download and stream handling for Marketo warehouse ingestion, potentially affecting CSV parsing and resource cleanup.
review.reason: Adds a try/finally block and a new response.raw.auto_close=False attribute; also reorders the JSON-content-type check and its return to occur before the CSV stream wrapper, while retaining the original CSV parsing and chunked yielding.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit of the resource cleanup and response handling is not demonstrated by the code, but the change is substantive and bounded, not a narrow maintenance or documentation update.
